response.description: This release adds Microsoft Marketplace as a new discovery and procurement channel for Dragon Copilot AI apps and agents. Dragon Copilot customers in the United States can now discover, evaluate and purchase Dragon Copilot Physician Apps and Agents through Microsoft Marketplace.Dragon Copilot Physician Apps and Agents enhance clinical workflows using advanced AI for documentation guidance, information surfacing, and task automation. These solutions help physicians in creating, summarizing, searching, automating, and analyzing data—helping improve efficiency, clinician wellbeing, patient experience, and care delivery. Dragon Copilot is part of Microsoft for Healthcare and is built on a modern architecture with enhanced security.Purchasing through Microsoft Marketplace removes the need to onboard a new vendor or navigate separate procurement processes. Customers can acquire Dragon Copilot Physician Apps and Agents through a streamlined purchase experience with consolidated billing through Microsoft.   Learn more.
response.title: Generally Available: Dragon Copilot Physician Apps and Agents on Microsoft Marketplace
